A **Workshop on Time Series Analysis** for official statistics will be held at OECD, Paris, La Muette, France on **December 8th and 9th 2026**.

Abstract submission closed on September 30th 2026.


[Discover the workshop→](https://www.oecd.org/en/events/2026/12/6th-workshop-on-time-series-analysis-for-official-statistics.html)

Pdf page [here](Call_for_Papers_OECD_8-9-Dec2026.pdf).
